dossier.mission: Exercise fail-closed worker behavior when a task lease expires during execution.
requirements: The executor must stop the active child when lease renewal fails.
acceptance_criteria: The active child is terminated before its own completion marker is written.

task.title: Verify executor termination after lease loss
task.request_text: Run a deliberately long child process and expire its lease from the CI administrator connection.
acceptance_criteria: The executor detects failed lease renewal.
The stale worker cannot finish or transition the task.
